description: Copy a file from a public http(s) URL to Wiro, up to about 100 MB, and get a Wiro link back. Model file fields take public URLs directly, so use this only when the same file feeds several runs. Single files only, not .zip archives. A file that is only attached in the chat has no URL: ask the user for a public link.

file_name.description: Optional filename. Defaults to the URL filename.

url.description: URL of the file to upload (image, audio, video, or document).

name: upload_file
title: Upload a file to Wiro
